complete_body_review: Read all eight event branches: manifest replaces stage records and activates; stage replaces one record; log retains a 500-entry ring; complete clears active/error/unsupported; failed retains the error and clears setup choice; unsupported stores installation help; setup-choice clears prior manifest/stages/error and stores presentation facts; dismissed resets the snapshot.

Read both native-window liveness guards and final raw-event send. State is updated before optional broadcast, allowing a reloaded renderer to retrieve the snapshot. Unknown event kinds are still forwarded without changing the stored state; this remains an internal producer contract, not arbitrary-input validation.

The extra CC is the local fallback in setup-choice. bundled is derived from installShape/immutable INSTALL_STAMP rather than accepting a renderer-controlled artifact claim. promptFirstRunSetupChoice also emits the same native-derived fields; older missing local values retain the none presentation.

Complete first-run gate and startup orchestration reads show that Continue Local retains the choice until manifest takes ownership, remote Apply hides/dismisses only an active waiter, normal retry resets the snapshot, and repair reopens the gate. No changed callback evaluation or ownership transfer is introduced by the two added setup-choice fields.
findings.structural_rationale: CC 25 is concentrated in one synchronous event-to-snapshot dispatcher with shallow nesting 2 and 72 owned lines. The added local default and native artifact fact are cohesive setup-choice presentation normalization. Complete-body and binding review found no specific integration compatibility conflict; a source-bound CC-only disposition could be considered, with no growth permission or behavioral waiver.

PROFILE_NAME_RE binds DESKTOP_PROFILE_NAME_RE /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$/. Entries are selected by Object.entries; __proto__ is rejected by that grammar. This is disk JSON normalization, not an evaluator or network operation.

Read complete normalizeRemoteProfileName: trim, same profile grammar, reserved hermes/test/tmp/root/sudo exclusion; default remains valid. Invalid/blank mappings are omitted, preserving historical same-name fallback.

Read the direct JSON-read caller, routing override helpers and profileRouteOptions. The persisted desktop label remains the map key; validated remoteProfile reaches backendProfile only through the existing override selection. The URL/SSH/cloud precedence and explicit self-query mapping remain separate policies.

Read token/header envelope boundaries. The sanitizer neither decrypts nor changes token-storage policy. normalizeRemoteHeaders filters reserved header names; decryptRemoteHeaders strips CR/LF after decryption. These observations do not establish credential security or authorize those separate behaviors.
findings.structural_rationale: CC 26 comes from one bounded per-profile normalization pass, with 99 owned lines and nesting 4.
